dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: One prominent closed O-shaped annulus in the upper-mid dorsal region showing a sharp gradient from a dark perimeter to a high-intensity light core; two secondary C-shaped structures located immediately posterior and lateral with similar high-contrast edge definition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of light-intensity pixel clusters localized within the interior of the dorsal annuli and as asymmetrical, non-gradient patches along the upper lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Spatial relationship defined by an obtuse triangle formed by the centroids of the primary dorsal O-ring, the secondary lateral C-ring, and a distinct high-intensity blob located on the anterior flank.
